content: Hello, thanks for contacting account support. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I'm helping my daughter regain access to her online profile. She can't remember her password.
No problem. To get started, could you please provide her username or email address linked to the account?
Thank you. I'm sending a verification code to the recovery email on file. Once she receives it, could you enter the six-digit code here?
Got it, the code just came through: 187543.
Perfect, the code matched. Next, please click the 'Reset Password' link I’ve emailed to jessica.miller92’s address and follow the instructions to set a new password.
She clicked the link and changed her password. Should we do anything else?
That’s all set! For added security, I recommend she updates her security questions and confirms her phone number in the account settings.
Will do. Thank you for your help!
